summary: Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. application quashed by High Court; review of veracity of rape allegations; two-year delay unexplained; consideration of Lalita Kumari precedential misapplication; Magistrate's authority on evidentiary merits; Priyanka Srivastava and Suresh Kankra cited on judicial scrutiny standards; interplay of procedural timeliness versus prima facie legitimacy; appeals allowed reversing High Court's remand directive.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment quashed; Section 156(3) application dismissal sustained.
